move: top news card swipes off up-left blurring, stack springs forward one step
how: A phone mock-up over a blurred ocean wall shows four frosted news cards stacked with depth: each deeper card is translated 22px down, scaled 0.07 smaller, blurred 4px more and darkened. Every D/4 the top card flies translate(-340,-180), rotates -14 degrees, shrinks 0.9 and blurs 18px over the first 32% of the segment (quartic ease-out) while fading, then re-enters at the back rising with opacity; the remaining cards move up one depth with a damped-cosine spring over 45% of the segment. The phone wallpaper and the wall drift on one full circle per loop. All state is computed from t in a seek function.
adapt: Replace the stories array (source, tag, headline, blurb, three blob colours), the header and side copy; keep SEG = D / cards, the 0.32 swipe fraction and the spring constants.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the wall, phone and .stack cards; animate(el, shot, D) returns a gsap timeline with one {t:0->D, ease:none} tween whose onUpdate runs the seek(t) placement. Replace document.querySelector('.wallpaper'/'.wall') with el.querySelector.
caveats: per-frame filter: blur() on four cards plus backdrop-filter glass and two full-frame blurred images is heavy
no GSAP in the original; the port must wrap the seek function in a tween
